categories.main_business_segments: Permian Resources Corporation operates as an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, and optimization of crude oil and liquids-rich natural gas reserves. Its primary business segment is the exploration and production (E&P) of oil and gas, with all operations concentrated in the Delaware Basin, a sub-basin of the Permian Basin in West Texas and New Mexico.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing techniques to develop its assets, targeting multiple stacked pay zones such as the Bone Spring and Wolfcamp formations. It employs modern completion methods, including multi-well pad drilling and optimized fracture stimulation, to maximize recovery and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Permian Resources primarily serves large integrated oil companies, midstream processors, and commodity traders, with a small number of significant purchasers accounting for the majority of its revenues (e.g., BP America, Shell Trading, Enterprise Crude Oil). Its end markets are the U.S. crude oil, natural gas, and NGL markets, with sales at prevailing market prices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in the core of the Delaware Basin, spanning large contiguous acreage blocks in West Texas (primarily Reeves and Ward Counties) and southeastern New Mexico (Lea and Eddy Counties). Approximately 69% of its acreage is in Texas and 31% in New Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: Permian Resources operates upstream in the oil and gas supply chain, focusing on exploration, drilling, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs. It does not own significant midstream or downstream assets but relies on third-party gathering, processing, and transportation providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include disciplined production growth, sustainable free cash flow generation, and maximizing shareholder returns through optimized asset development and accretive acquisitions. R&D efforts are centered on technical innovation in drilling and completion, operational efficiency, and responsible resource development, with a focus on ESG and regulatory compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Permian Resources generates revenue primarily through the sale of produced crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs at market-based prices, with most contracts having terms greater than twelve months. Revenue is recognized at the point of transfer of control to customers, and the company also utilizes hedging to manage commodity price risk.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both major integrated and independent oil and gas producers in the Permian Basin, such as Pioneer Natural Resources, Devon Energy, and EOG Resources. Permian Resources positions itself as a leading pure-play Delaware Basin operator with a high-quality, contiguous asset base and significant operational control.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, Permian Resources reported total assets of $8.5 billion and total revenues of $2.13 billion, with net income attributable to Class A shareholders of $515 million. The company experienced significant growth in 2022, more than doubling its proved reserves to 582 MMBoe and increasing production by 57% year-over-year, driven by the merger with Colgate Energy Partners III.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Permian Resources emphasizes its high-quality, contiguous acreage in the core of the Delaware Basin, operational control over 96% of its net leasehold, and technical expertise in horizontal drilling and completion. Its value proposition centers on sustainable, high-return growth, capital efficiency, and the ability to generate free cash flow and return capital to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
